contexts.text: When expelled, they sit solitary.
See Right. AC 3387:4. AC 9133:end. CL 21:2. TCR 136:4.
Sitting at the tent door. Explained.
Sitting at the gate of Sodom. Explained.
Hagar sat by herself () = a state of thought. Explained. AC 2688.
To sit () involves something of tranquillity.
She sat upon them () = that they are interior.
Occurs. AC 5313:2, Illustrated. AC 7780. AC 8685. AC 8689. AC 10415.
The seat which theft occupies, and from which it ejects goods and truths. AC 5135:9.
When evils and falsities occupy the seat.
The Lord then removes the goods and truths of infancy from that seat.
He sat upon the bed () = that it was turned to the Natural. Explained.
He shall sit in the might of his bow () = safe by the truth of doctrine fighting. To sit = to be safe.
When those in Jupiter sit. Described.
While they sit at table, they sit upon leaves of the fig.
In our sitting by the flesh pot () = life according to their pleasure.
Sit for us in this () = remain in the external sense.

For to sit = to remain in a state. For progressions = changes of state; hence sittings = remainings in a state; and therefore it was a ritual to sit when they were representing a permanent state of the interiors. Illustrated.
The influent love and wisdom would have no seat.
They assigned the seat of the soul... TCR 697.
Such sit mute in the dark.
No one can sit anywhere but in his own place...
They depart, and sit sad.
They sit solitary and idle.
To sit with the Lord in His throne () = conjunction with Him in Heaven. AR 222. AE 253.

He who sat upon the throne () = the Lord as to Judgment. ( = the Lord as to the Divine Itself. AR 256. AR 273. AR 291. AR 339. AR 368.) ( = the Lord as to the Divine good in Heaven. AE 297. AE 343. AE 412. AE 460:3. AE 482.)
Therefore a hypocrite... sits mute.
He who sat on him () = a man angel.
He who sat upon the cloud () = the Lord as to the Word. AR 645. AR 646.
The harlot who sits upon many waters ()... To sit upon them = to be and live in them.
Who sitteth upon the throne () = the Lord as the God of Heaven and the Judge of the universe. AR 808:2, Illustrated. AR 865:2. AR 886:2.
He who sat upon the white horse () = the Lord as to the Word.
They said. Let us not stand before them, but sit.
Whoever enters the place of worship knows his own place, and cannot sit elsewhere...
I replied, I have been led here to see and hear, but not to sit down. TCR 48:2.
They sit in torment. SE 4111.
Some Spirits appear sitting, upon a seat.
When they have sat thus a long time, perhaps for many ages, their externals are as it were dead, and they can be formed into something. SE 4038.
Meanwhile they sit like skeletons...
He sat meditating...
On their temples, and how they sit.
How Spirits are explored from their seats in a house.
Horses = intellectual truths; those who sit upon them = spiritual truths. See AE 575.
To sit on the earth was a sign of mourning...

Standings and sittings belong to man's quiet, and thence = the esse of life from which is its existere, thus to cause to live; and therefore to sit upon thrones = to be in the work of Judgment; hence to sit in Judgment = to do Judgment; and to sit upon a throne = to be a king, or to reign. Illustrated.
To sit () is expressive of the life of the will, thus of the esse of the life.
As the Lord is the Esse itself of the life of all, to sit is said of Him. Illustrated.
To sit = to be. Illustrated.
To sit = to be, and also to remain in a state, and is of the will. Illustrated. AE 687:end.
To sit in the ways () = to insidiate.
To sit = to dominate. AE 1062. AE 1076.
